doc.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: First European tour with Coltrane: the shopping-bag luggage
summary: He recalls going to Europe with Trane with dirty shirts and a shopping bag instead of a suitcase.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: And then it seems as if the next time you went to Europe was with Coltrane. You went earlier with J.J. Johnson, but is this the second time you went to Europe, with 'Trane?
Do you want to talk about that tour, that first one?

I don’t really remember much about it. The only thing that sticks with me is when we go on the stage and play. The rest of it I don’t pay that much attention to. I know I didn’t have a suitcase. I had this beat up tuxedo and these shirts. All of them were dirty. I couldn’t find a place to get my shirts cleaned so I washed them myself. And I didn’t have a suitcase, I picked up a shopping bag and I put my stuff in there. Well we got in the train

station, getting ready to take a train, sitting down waiting for the time to go. And when its time to board and I get up and start boarding the train. And John is right behind me and he says, “Oh you forgot your luggage!” (Laughs)
